synthetic_initial_inputs.name: xr-test

source_boundaries.status: 30 slots; first invalid/empty/UTF8>=16byte ends; exactly30 occupied resets count0
source_boundaries.metadata: cols retained with zero data for unhandled metadata; no count normalization
source_boundaries.cipher: library AES-128 ECB PKCS7 substitute, original hardware CE not native PASS
source_boundaries.keys: generic1465a6c; device1465244; persistent1465181; startup copy existing persisted or generate alnum16
source_boundaries.discovery: native two lock members0 then cache420; safe model single effective cached lock
source_boundaries.fault: unknown name faults native null strcmp at476; safe model whole-batch InvalidPacket
source_boundaries.timer: CRUD delegates to exact timer helper; reply always device key1465244 with cached sourceflag14671de (scan/bind1,status/cmd0), not request i. Timer scheduling drives source countdown/UART state, not root-cache commands.
source_boundaries.upgrade: native external download/OTA path has no local response; no hostIO or fakeACK
source_boundaries.provisioning: Outer plaintext wlan(host,ssid,psw,lat,lon), native ret/r200/mac plaintext LF; persists current device key then resets source network stack. Model retains bounded per-device memory only, no host network or physical reboot.
source_boundaries.clock: Virtual UTC advances on server tick and operations; explicit time setter calls source timer refresh, not elapsed scheduler dispatch.

safe_policy: atomic pending deep copy before any cache/clock mutation
strict int32/string commands; reject other native no-op types
strict valid nonnegative signed32 UTC calendar instead of native atoi normalization
bounded string copies, property arrays and reply scratch
strict matching outer target and reject conflicting inner MAC/sub
no host filesystem, network, mainboard or calibrated physics
wlan safe UTF8 byte bounds host19/ssid64/psw63/lat10/lon10 replace native unchecked copies; actual network reconnection/boot not synthesized
